units.patch_xy: CNN feature-grid coordinates from original grid/patchify

units.intrinsics_division: Image K divided by original RES4 exactly once inside frozen _append
units.keyframe_flow: Mean beta0.5 weighted full-motion and translation-only projected feature-grid XY Euclidean displacement, then average both source/target directions; original ignores validity mask here
units.motion_probe: Median0.5 of learned Update delta.norm; delta is added to projected feature-grid patch center before BA. Its unit is feature pixels but learned responses need not scale exactly after image resizing.
